root_cause_analysis.waiting_query: ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS ONLY public.uploaded_documents DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS uploaded_documents_case_id_fkey;
root_cause_analysis.explanation: In test_scenario_b_logical_deletion_pitr, SQLAlchemy session executed a SELECT query leaving the connection in 'idle in transaction' holding SharedLock on case_files. restore_backup_package then called pg_restore via subprocess.run, which requested ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock on case_files. Because Python was blocked synchronously waiting for subprocess.run, neither could advance, causing a permanent deadlock.
